topics.topic: Semantics of resolving `outcome_unknown` (whether resolution can be refused and how it affects node/run conclusion)
questions: Can `resolve unknown outcome` be refused, or must it always succeed as State 0 implies?
How must the executor compute node conclusion, dependant eligibility, and final run status when NodeExecution status remains `outcome_unknown` but A11 says the element counts succeeded/failed?

topics.topic: When binding-validation checks must be enforced/refused (accept-time vs later checks)
questions: Should `accept binding` have no domain refusals, or should it refuse on unknown/stale/mismatch as A08 states?
Must duplicate required-header names be rejected at binding proposal/acceptance time, only at send-time stale check, or both?

topics.topic: Behavior of repeated run-advance on an unconcluded mapped node (re-execute concluded elements or skip)
questions: When the run advances again (approval/resume/restart) and the mapped node is still unconcluded, are already-concluded elements re-executed or skipped?

topics.topic: Canonical failure-reason vocabulary for manifest/check mismatches
questions: What exact reason codes/text must be emitted for each failing check so behavior is deterministic across implementations?

topics.topic: Exact HTTP query URL-encoding and repeated-key serialization rules
questions: Which exact URL-encoding algorithm must be used for query keys/string values (UTF-8 percent-encoding set, space as `%20` vs `+`, repeated key serialization details)?

topics.topic: Representation and admission comparison rules for function file outputs
questions: How are function file outputs represented in TrialExecution and compared in admission when expected outputs are present?
What `attempt_number` must a `refused_by_owner` NodeExecution carry, since refusal creates a NodeExecution but is not an execution/send attempt?

topics.topic: Timing of flow-constant materialization/validation during run advancement
questions: When, in run advancement, are flow constants materialized and validated for node readiness (e.g., at run start, lazily when node selected, or another point)?

topics.topic: Whether unconnected `file`-carriage flow I/O declarations must cause composition/proof refusal
questions: If a composed flow declares a flow input/output with `file` carriage but that port is not part of any checked edge, must composition/proof refuse it?
